}}'''Caira''' is a serving girl at [[The Wandering Woman]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Caira}}

==Appearance==
[[Matrim Cauthon]] describes her as a "smoky-eyed cat." {{ref/book|9|19}}

==Activities==
When Mat comes to The Wandering Woman from the [[Tarasin Palace]], Caira tells him that an [[Illuminator]], [[Aludra]], was looking for him.{{ref/book|7|17}} Caira becomes jealous when [[Birgitte Silverbow]] is in Mat's room on [[Swovan Night]].{{ref/book|7|21}} She becomes even more jealous when [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]] ask her about Mat.{{ref/book|7|22}} Caira is still angry with Mat when he starts to move out of The Wandering Woman.{{ref/book|7|28}} [[Marah Anan]] once snapped at Caira to work faster.{{ref/book|9|19}}
